PaymentReference.title: PaymentReference
PaymentReference.description: Publicly queryable payment reference record managed exclusively by administrators.

referenceNumber.description: Numeric payment reference identifier matching the document ID.

concept.description: Short description or concept of the payment.

amount.description: Amount to pay in Colombian Pesos (COP).

status.description: Current payment status of the reference.

dueDate.description: Optional due date in YYYY-MM-DD format or empty string.

paymentUrl.description: Optional HTTPS payment gateway URL or empty string.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the reference was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

updatedBy.description: UID of the administrator who created or last updated the record.

AdminAccess.title: AdminAccess
AdminAccess.description: Authorized administrator registry keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

active.description: Indicates whether this administrator account is active.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/payment_references/{referenceNumber}.description: Numeric payment references looked up individually by exact ID and managed by admins.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Registry of authorized admin UIDs managed by the bootstrap administrator.
